about: Recorded ambience beds for tools/lyria_sfx.js --kind amb. id = the procedural bed of R.Audio.ambience (core/audio.js, "ambience" section) or an extra variant of one (bed = the spec it stands for: breeze_night = {bed:"breeze", night:1}, rain_shore = {bed:"rain", surf}, ship = {bed:"sea", muffled}, forest_night = {bed:"forest", night:1}, cave_dry = {bed:"cave", dry:true}). lufs: the integrated loudness the file is normalised to — the level of the procedural bed at strength 1 / volume 10 (measured there: blizzard -33, sandstorm -34, sea -36, rain -37, forest -41, heat -43 LUFS), so a file plays at unity gain on the amb bus.
